title: Tyler's claimed time-travel group with Townsend Brown in NASA and the Bahamas
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tyler's claimed time-travel group with Townsend Brown in NASA and the Bahamas, about mid-20th century at NASA and Nassau, Bahamas, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
